description: Land Acquisition - Mahaheella, Beliatta D/S Division, Hambanthota District and Pitihuma, Kegalle D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired for public purposes (Southern Expressway extension), including lot numbers, extents, boundaries, and location details. While it mentions a government minister (Gayantha Karunatilleke), this is incidental to the core land acquisition function, and there are no detailed portfolio responsibilities described beyond the ministerial title. The content fits squarely within the Land Gazette category as it concerns land acquisition, property descriptions, and land use for infrastructure projects.
